links.outcome: peer ratings of physician skill and competence
links.effect: Verification improved vs primary: clinical skills 4.99 vs 3.79; competence 4.94 vs 3.71, both p < 0.001; still below control.
links.quote: Presenting GenAI as a verification tool partially mitigated this effect, though the clinical skills rating remained lower than in the Control condition (F(1, 273) = 28.99, p < 0.001, η p ² = 0.10).
